notes.title: Order from Caos 2 is now Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
White Vortex Games is honored to announce that the second game in the RPG series Order from Caos, released in 2023, has achieved the Steam Deck Verified certification. Order from Caos 2 has been approved as a great experience on the device, providing great immersion on the Steam Deck.

Steam Deck Verified is a quality seal granted by Steam, recognizing excellence in game performance for the Steam Deck portable console. This certification assures players that the White Vortex's title will provide a smooth gaming experience on Valve's hardware.

"Receiving the Steam Deck Verified seal for the second time is the result of a lot of hard work. We are very happy to see Order from Caos 2 approved and running so well on the Steam Deck. It's recognition of our effort and commitment to the player. It's a great choice for RPG fans," says Renan Barreto, CEO of the studio.

The RPG game from White Vortex, now Steam Deck Verified, is available for purchase and download on the Steam platform.

For those who are not familiar, Order from Caos 2 features:

[list]
[*] Over 20 hours of gameplay
[*] 100 Steam Achievements
[*] 100 enemies
[*] 30 Special moves and spells
[*] Over 50 Quests
[*] Skill grid
[*] 6 protagonists
[/list]

Just like Order from Caos 2, the first game in the Order from Caos series (2020) also has the Steam Deck Verified certification.

About White Vortex: White Vortex is a game development studio dedicated to creating engaging and innovative experiences for players worldwide. With a commitment to quality and creativity, White Vortex constantly seeks to bring the best of its stories to life.

notes.title: 5 side quest you should do in Order from Caos 2
notes.content:
I know that the main story is like the main course of a restaurant, but there are those good stories that can be savored in a slightly more restrained way, yet still remain tasty. Therefore, as a developer, I chose 5 sidequests that caught my attention and evoked different emotions when I wrote them. It's good to remember that there may be spoilers at some points, nothing that compromises the main story, but I reveal some details about the sidequests.

[b]1 - Gertrudes (Judy)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/b12e5297a213c77c0c435b8797496892328d49b2.jpg[/img]

I know many people complain because they lose a battle to a poor chicken... or should I say rooster? Well, the battle isn't really as difficult as it seems; just explore the city, and at level 2, the fight becomes easy. It's important to note that it's not possible to finish this sidequest after the Boss Duong battle at the lake. But why is this sidequest about a chicken important? Well, in Order from Caos (2020), there was a chicken near the protagonist's house, and it was the first time I tested how to program a Steam Achievement as a developer. That's why I carry this love for poultry in the series.


[b]2 - Maria[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/953d01677fd4e6ebb321206964f2031d3eeff63f.jpg[/img]

Maria was a sidequest that exhausted me during its creation. There were characters in different places that needed to deal with variables that changed according to the progress of the main plot. It was one of the sidequests that flirted with the darker side since it made sense to have a kind of haunting being exorcised in the churchyard. I also felt that it's important to highlight this sidequest because, upon closer inspection, there's a hint of discussion about each person's role in society. Despite the good relationship between the two involved, they were still reflections of Bratania's society.


[b]3 - All the Viridis are gone[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/13964811c702e0cdef5fb724682a75731e6ec218.jpg[/img]

Well... This sidequest is special because it's very complex to complete. The player needs to find almost 30 viridis to achieve this achievement and unlock Alicia's full power. To accomplish this feat, the player must have initially defeated all the viridis. Each defeated viridi releases its completely green counterpart. These are the viridis that cling to our world and refuse to depart. At that moment, the player needs to find it on the map and defeat it, releasing its power for Alicia to use. This sidequest touches my soul because we're talking about Alicia, a girl who discovers her strength by borrowing the powers of beings that are her enemies. Besides, it's a way for her to show how special she is.


[b]4 - Personal Tunnel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/1beee80d629b7ed4bd6cf1e63d157e1482b54113.jpg[/img]

I see this sidequest as a tribute to one of my favorite manga authors, Junji Ito. In the game, a man talks about the existence of a personal tunnel that would take the individual's soul to the other world. Indeed, he is a sad and hopeless man. In the end, when you are already in Hell, in the other world, you meet the man again. Indeed, he had a tunnel for himself. It's a more visual reference to Ito's work, but here is the homage.


[b]5 - State of the Art[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/dcd7511e1c35615bc2929f30c8c3ff9d255d88dd.jpg[/img]

Oscar is a name signaled several times in some sculptures throughout the game. These monuments can be seen in some cities, usually seen as gifts to the cities. When the player actually finds Oscar, he is debilitated and feels very unappreciated by society, life, and people who can see the value in art and what it represents for human beings. He basically dies without knowing that his art was appreciated. I find this sidequest especially important because it discusses the value we give to the artist who creates the art we consume. He devoted his life to this purpose and left the cities with important symbols for each one. In the end, tragedy was his reward.


[b]Bonus - Strange Symbols[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/81f482ce1c067a19fb3d401052f37018b1bbc80e.jpg[/img]

I know I said I would talk about 5 sidequests, but I think it's necessary to talk about this one too. When I created the 5 Primordials, I thought about making a DLC with them, but I decided to delay the game's release by three months to polish it better and deliver as much content as possible. There are five special dungeons along the journey with unique puzzles and the possibility of fighting remnants of the most powerful beings in the Order from Caos 2 universe, at least those presented in the game. It's an optional sidequest, but I strongly suggest doing it because there are subtexts in some sidequests that, when combined, make the player understand the story a little better as a whole. But don't worry. It's possible to understand the main story by playing from start to finish.

I've talked a lot already. I want to thank everyone who was able to play. It's always great to see people playing. Some send me messages here or by email, and I'm happy with all the feedback. I hope you continue to follow me in the next stories. I have some to share with you, my friends.

Until next time.

[b]Renan Barreto[/b]
Game Dev
whitevortex.com.br

notes.title: New Game Plus
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

I hope you're well and enjoying Order from Caos 2. It was an enormous effort that took over 2 years and 2,000 hours to create. There's a lot of content within the game, and all feedback is welcome.

I'd like to talk about the New Game Plus mode.

You can finish the game and start over while keeping your attributes and experience points. Remember that the second time you play, the monsters will be stronger, but they will also drop more items, more gold, and more experience points.

I hope you all complete the game at your own pace and can savor every moment that Order from Caos 2 has to offer.

Thank you all for your feedback.

See you soon.

Thank you!

notes.title: Order from Caos 2 is 10 days away!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. This is Renan, the game developer of Order from Caos 2.

I'm exhausted but very happy. The game is complete, and now I'm working on translations for other languages. It took years to produce this game, and I hope all of you, my friends who enjoy turn-based RPGs, can have fun with Order from Caos 2.

For those who already know, you'll be aware that the game has no relation to the first one. So, you can play without fear. Everyone will start without knowing anything.

I'll be honest here, making games is exhausting, but it's so rewarding. While playing the game to test some bugs, I got emotional because I felt like the characters were alive. It was as if they were my actual companions. I wrote the story in 2006, started turning it into a game in 2020, and I'm only publishing it now. It's a joy and a relief to be able to share this story with you.

My only wish is that we can exchange ideas about the game and the characters that inhabit this world.

In the original Order from Caos, some talked about how satisfying it was to defeat nihilists. In Order from Caos 2, the fight is against domination, against those who control. It can be control over regions, people, or the future.

Anyway, I wrote this because I wanted to proudly share with you that Order from Caos 2 is officially ready and will be officially launched at Brasil Game Show, the largest game event in Latin America, for an audience of over 300,000 people.

We've had over 16,000 downloads of the demo. I can't wait to chat with you when the game is out.

Buy the game here on Steam. See you in the next update.

See you in the next update.

Until next time.

notes.title: Order from Caos 2: 100 achievements and more features
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is Renan, the developer of Order from Caos 2.

August has arrived.

We are getting closer to the release of Order from Caos 2. I want to thank you all for the messages of support, suggestions, and feedback. All the feedback has been essential in shaping the game to what it is now.

I would like to announce that Order from Caos 2 is playable from start to finish. Everything is ready. Currently, I am mainly looking for possible bugs and thoroughly testing all aspects of the game. Additionally, I am working on balancing the game. I intend to keep it challenging. There will be some grinding involved, but players who explore the world thoroughly may be rewarded and won't find battles too harsh. My goal is not to create a Dark Souls level of difficulty, so no worries, but I also don't want to make an RPG with no challenges at all.

I have implemented some requested features and added others:

[list]
[*] Enemy cards now display indications of attack types that can deal more damage and those that are more resistant.

[*] The game features 100 properly configured achievements.

[*] There are a total of 55 quests, including main and side quests.

[*] I've added a few more special weapons for the characters.

[*] Weapons are no longer locked and do not replace previous weapons. Previously, with each upgrade, the previous weapon was discarded. That doesn't happen anymore. However, you won't be able to sell weapons anywhere.

[*] Some monsters have undergone changes in their sprites.

[*] I've added a few more scenes to better understand the story and mechanics.

[*] There are 80 cards to be found throughout the game. The cards can be viewed in the bestiary.

[*] The biggest change in recent days, and the one that gave me the most work, was implementing the NEW GAME PLUS functionality. After completing Order from Caos 2, you can start New Game Plus and keep all weapons, armor, cards, levels, abilities, money, and achievements.
[/list]

I hope I can count on all of you in this journey. I'm counting down the days to share all this work that started back in 2019 with you.

Here are some more screenshots. And don't forget to add Order from Caos 2 to your Wishlist.

Until next time.

Renan Barreto
Game Dev - White Vortex

notes.title: July Update of Order from Caos 2
notes.content:
Hello, this is Renan, the game dev responsible for Order from Caos 2.

I hope you're doing well.

As usual, I'm here to provide an update on the game's progress. The release date is approaching. October 11, 2023 is just around the corner.

In July, I finally finished the story events and all the main quests. This means that the game is now playable from start to finish. I must admit that I became a bit emotional with the development of this game. I've spent several years with these characters. It will be difficult to get used to meeting new ones in future projects.

Furthermore, I managed to complete the artwork for 98% of the NPCs and possibly 95% of the game's enemies. I finished the events related to 55% of the side quests. I'm making an effort to ensure that most of the side quests help to better understand the lore of the game's universe or tell stories that make sense within the overall storyline.

There are some things I would love to add, such as more scenarios, but if I do so, I believe I won't have enough time to deliver the game on time. However, I want to make it clear that I haven't cut anything, I'm just not going to add more.

Working alone is always a challenging task, and creating an RPG of this magnitude using the few remaining hours of the day is even more difficult to accomplish. That's why I've been working on it for so long. The most important thing is to stay focused. This game has been in the works since before the release of the original Order from Chaos, which came out in 2020.

Finally, I want to thank everyone for their ongoing support. I'm sure we'll have many discussions about specific characters and actions. Just a reminder that this is a story-focused game, but you'll need to make an effort to upgrade weapons, find Lumenis throughout the scenarios, and defeat many viridis (enemies that roam the world of OfC2).

To make things easier, there will be a certain point where fast travel will be possible. I'll bring back some opportunities to earn gold and experience faster... But it's a secret.

And here are some more monsters and new screenshots for you.

Until next time.

notes.title: June Update of Order from Caos 2
notes.content:
Hello, my friends.

This is Renan, the Game Dev working on Order from Caos 2. It's time to talk about the development process and bring some news about the game.

Wow! I've been working on this game for a long time. The initial version of the story started in 2006 or 2007, and the second version, more robust with more characters and details, was written in 2019. But I continue to add content to make the world as alive as possible.

Well, let's get to it. Here's what I've been doing.

I'm happy to say that the main campaign is already 95% playable. There's very little left to finish. However, there are still some scenarios to change and some final enemies to create.

[b]Demo vs. Final Version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/96c8868bfba5e182084b2b1199fdc2f4282b03ad.png[/img]

Daena's battle sprites have been changed.
Another dimension has a new variable. Now you can't have that ability on all the time. You need to level up to keep it active for longer.
When fighting an enemy, the player no longer faces the defeated enemy to avoid encountering them repeatedly.
Numbers for Lumenis Points and their relation to weapon purchases have been updated.
Balancing of battles has been adjusted.
Grinding is still necessary, but there are various ways to become stronger in the game. Exploring the environment is essential.
It's possible to escape from all non-boss battles.

[b]Special Dungeons:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/b4422945c69c98625eba8eb643895ed82a569d21.png[/img]

In Order from Caos 2, I've added special dungeons with slightly more challenging bosses. So, get ready to become stronger. When you finish all of them, you'll be greatly rewarded. Although they are part of a side quest, they have a strong connection to the main story.

[b]Battle System:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/4e13523e7038fdce921ea01eb3d3e0f3fd9215ae.png[/img]

The battle system features character positioning in rows. The closer a character is to the enemy, the stronger their physical attacks and weaker their defense. The farther away from the enemy, the stronger their defense and magical attacks, and weaker their physical attacks. Each character has their own characteristics, and it's up to you to choose the best way to use them.

[b]Summoning:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/afb83d7e26d643279463adbd80c27f7d1e149020.png[/img]

Just like in Order from Caos in 2020, summoning is back. They are always related to the main story. We didn't have any in the demo, but you'll encounter them during your journey.

[b]Team:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/fd34ad194230c22debaaf8c5a8bb86f728eaf2f9.png[/img]

There will always be 6 playable characters. Additionally, some extra characters will appear in the story and can be used in combat as team members. I won't reveal who they are to avoid spoilers.

[b]Enemies:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/6302fb08d2e3598682a73d5f79855d8faf09c3cf.png[/img]

All enemies are visible on the map.
There are no random encounters.
I'm aiming to have between 60 and 70 enemies. Currently, 59 of them are ready. I believe I should have around 65 enemies in total, but it may change until the final game release.

[b]DLC:[/b]

The game won't have any DLCs. I believe RPGs shouldn't have DLCs. They should be complete stories that can be enjoyed within the scope of the game.

[b]NPCs:[/b]

In terms of world NPCs, I'd say the progress is still at 50%. But it will progress rapidly. I decided to focus on finishing the main story first.

[b]Sidequests:[/b]

I'm working more than I imagined on them. I'm working on the concepts to make them all feel like they're part of the main story. My goal is for all sidequests to be played as part of the main campaign.

[b]Achievements:[/b]

Players will have many achievements to unlock. There are dozens of them.

[b]Viridis and Powers:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182689/e9f69d800000d52045208f429483ce740a5160f9.png[/img]

The viridis are the common enemies in the game. You don't fight against wild animals. The world has been taken over by these creatures. But at a certain point in the game, you'll encounter special versions of them that will grant unique powers to a certain character.

That's it for now. I hope you continue to follow and have the assurance that I'm working hard to deliver a fun and unique game. I can't thank all the players and friends enough for their feedback throughout the development process. You're all very important.

Thank you, and until the next update post.

Renan Barreto, Game Dev - White Vortex.

notes.title: Order from Caos 2 receives release date
notes.content:
Order from Caos 2, the second game in the RPG series by White Vortex, will be released on October 11th on Steam for PC. The game has no connection to the events or characters shown in the first game of the series and functions as a standalone game.

Order from Caos 2 is a turn-based RPG with pixel art style, created and developed by Renan Barreto. It tells the story of Thomas, a man who lost his family, murdered by a mysterious and cruel Knight from the Empire of Bratania known as Asmodeus. Thomas embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to destroy his most ruthless enemy. However, there's a detail that can change everything: his family may have never existed at all. Haunted by both possible realities, Thomas must understand what lies behind this tragedy to define his tomorrow, which intertwines with the future of all humanity, even if it means going to hell.

The journey in Order from Caos 2 is unique and offers over 20 hours of gameplay, dozens of side quests, items, special moves, and many puzzles to solve. Enemies roam the environment, and there are no random encounters. Players will explore forests, cities, beaches, islands, temples, secret dungeons, hidden cities, and fight against powerful creatures. There is plenty to do in the game, even if players choose not to follow just the main story.

[b]Dimension Lights[/b]

In order to upgrade weapons and improve the stats of the team members, players will need to find Lumenis, luminous spheres scattered throughout the world but in another dimension. Lumenis can be found in many areas of the game.

[b]Battle Tactics[/b]

There are six playable characters in the game's main team. Each one possesses unique qualities, and it's up to the player to position them correctly in battle to make the most of their abilities. However, be careful. Some enemies can change the team's position in the middle of battle.

[b]Abilities[/b]

Each character has their own skill tree. Each locked block can be unlocked in exchange for Lumenis. It's up to the player to decide how to evolve their character. They can choose to unlock a new ability or open a path to increase the hero's specific stats.

Order from Caos 2 will have support for both controllers and keyboard. It will be released in Brazilian Portuguese and English. The demo version is already available on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918420/Order_from_Caos_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918420/Order_from_Caos_2/[/url]

notes.title: May updates: Order from Caos 2
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

I'm back to talk a bit about the game's development. I started producing it back in 2020, creating the first images, and now we're almost at the release period. How time flies. At this moment, I have almost all the maps ready, the story finalized, the final events nearly finished, and I'm wrapping up the last enemies. I've already created over 50 enemies with various positions. It takes a lot of effort and hard work to make a game of this size alone. But I'm almost there.

I want to say that every day there is progress, from Sunday to Sunday, so that I can deliver the game with the best possible quality to friends, partners, and fans.

The game is darker than Order from Caos 1 (2020). Thomás, the protagonist, needs to deal with even more complicated issues than Dan, the protagonist of the first Order from Caos. He deals with a personal revenge that consumes him day by day, but his allies are responsible for creating a balance in his feelings.

Order from Caos 2 doesn't share the same universe as the first game, meaning you can play the second one without having played the first. This is a completely new story.

Once I finish the main events, I'll move on to the sidequests and game balancing.

I appreciate everyone who gets in touch in any way, whether through social media, email, or even through Steam.

I want to deliver the high-quality product that everyone wants to enjoy.

And for those who haven't downloaded it yet, take advantage of the available demo.

Thank you all!

notes.title: Order from Caos 2 December updates
notes.content:
Hi guys. 

I want to share some updates on Order from Caos 2.

We promoted our demo at the Brasil Game Show with a booth in the Indie Area of ​​the event. It was a pretty cool experience. It was nice to know that other people, like me, love RPGs.

About the development itself, I can say that it is going well. It is hard to make sprites in the amount I planned. Some things were added to the game as new techniques for the character Alicia, whose design has not yet been released. She, after defeating certain enemies, gains special moves to use in battle. This means that she can use moves based on all enemies known as Viridis that exist within the game. I thought it would be cool to do that since there's a connection to this skill in the story. So, I needed to put into the gameplay what was just said in the dialogues.

Other cool things are the sidequests, too. I've been pushing hard to better integrate the sidequest stories into the world of Order from Caos 2 and the main quests. I want to simply avoid the old logic “NPC > Take an object or kill monster > Talk to NPC again”.

One of the sidequests I finished recently, for example, is connected with others. It is necessary to talk to a specific NPC, and have a fire summon to be able to knock down ice walls in a dungeon where another summon is. Besides, this is part of a much larger side quest that will indicate something in the later stages of the adventure. It's not about changing endings, but about adding content. It looks messy, but rest assured it looks natural in the game.

I've been developing the game since 2019, but I spent many months with the project on hold. I work on many projects at the same time. It's a lot of hard work to implement all of this on my own, but I'm pleased with where the development is going and how the characters are evolving every day.

I'm refining some areas and creating a lot. It's a lot of work to create animations, settings, monsters, items, and sprite sheets, and make all of this coherent within the story.

I would say the job is 25% done, but the speed is now also higher. I hope I can meet the release target date by mid-2023.

Rest assured, I am very committed to making a fun game that can also make us think about relevant issues, which generates good discussions.

I appreciate the support of all the 7,000+ players who downloaded the demo and all the kind friends I made in Order from Caos 1.

Thank you, and see you next time!

Renan Barreto

notes.title: Backroom Beyond is going to be available in July. Add to your wishlist
notes.content:
Backroom Beyond is a first-person game that mixes puzzles with single-player adventure in a dark, harrowing environment that makes the player question the protagonist's sanity. Based on the internet myth, Backroom Beyond goes further and makes the player wonder if that journey is about something more personal than anything else.

The narrative has two main points. Drawings tell part of the game's story on the walls. The drawings have no defined authorship, which gives them an extra degree of strangeness. The second point is the existence of The Guide, a being that instigates the players to think about their actions in real life.

The game basically has one objective throughout its 40-level journey: place the red box over the red button and open the door to the next level. It seems simple at first, but it's not. Each environment has its own logic. If the players feel frustrated because something went wrong in their strategy, they can press the “wake up again" button, which will return them to the beginning of the level.

Each scenario has a part of the story to be told, whether in the subway, in the snow, in the house, or in an actual backroom. Each place has its dose of tension and wonder.

The theme song chosen is Pérolas Irregulares (Irregular Pearls) by the band Terceiro Mundo Bom (Third Good World), whose clip has many similarities with the game's project.

[previewyoutube=pZKbzxEYNkw;full][/previewyoutube]

“I created this game because I could bring my contribution to the world of backrooms, which I was fascinated by. This myth has everything to do with the stories I tell about the existence of realities and universes that coexist and can collide. The story I set out to tell in Backroom Beyond is fragmented in a way that the player will need to interpret many of the elements. After all, who is The Guide? Who wrote on the walls? Has anyone been there before? Is it possible to leave?”, says Renan Barreto, creator of the game. “And being able to put in the game the song Pérolas Irregulares played by the band Terceiro Mundo Bom, which I'm a fan of is incredible. I could not be happier. The song and the video match very well with the proposal of the story and I would say that both complement each other”.

Backroom Beyond will be available on Steam on July 8th for Windows PC.


[b]Add to your wishlist.[/b]

notes.title: Order from Caos 2 demo is available now for free on Steam
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fhe9_9q_oOE;full][/previewyoutube]

Order from Caos 2 is a pixel art turn-based RPG created and developed by Renan Barreto from the White Vortex studio, and tells the story of Thomas, a man who lost his family, murdered by a mysterious and cruel Knight of the Bratania Empire, known by the name of Asmodeus. Thomas embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to destroy his most merciless enemy. However, there is one detail that could change everything, his family might’ve simply never existed at all. Haunted by both possible realities, Thomas needs to figure out what is behind all this tragedy to define his future that intertwines with the future of all humanity, even if it is about him going to Hell.

The journey of Order from Caos 2 is unique and has more than 20 hours of gameplay, dozens of sidequests, items, special moves, and many puzzles to solve. Enemies walk across the maps and there are no random encounters. The players will walk through forests, cities, beaches, islands, temples, secret dungeons, hidden cities and will fight powerful creatures. The players will have a lot to do in the game if they don’t want to just follow the main story.

Order from Caos 2 has no connection to the events or characters shown in the first game in the series and will be released soon on Steam for Windows PC. The demo is already live here on Steam.

"It's great to be able to deliver another RPG, a genre that I'm passionate about. I want to show all my appreciation to all of you who have supported me in this journey", says Renan, creator of Order from Caos 2.

For more information on the game, check out our site: [url=https://whitevortex.com.br/orderfromcaos2]https://whitevortex.com.br/orderfromcaos2[/url]
